Name: Heman, Son of Joel
Summary: Singer, son of Joel son of Shemuel, set by David over the service of song.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:33; 1 Chronicles 15:17: Singer, son of Joel son of Shemuel, set by David over the service of song.
LifeLesson: The mention of Heman in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
